scenicChapters.title: Back to German Alpine → Walchensee and Kochelsee Sweep fuel gate
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

munich-bavarian-alps-german-alpine-road-.story: A one-way ride of 594 km, Moosinning to Neufahrn bei Freising - roughly 12 h 42 in the saddle. On the way it passes Schrobenhausen, in Prittriching, near Penzberg and Grünwald. The climbs: near Tuntenhausen and near Grafing bei München. It tops out at about 1,000 m. Much of it runs through woodland.
